ARABIC — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Only memorise without using the language

2. When practising Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Conversational skills.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Conversational skills.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational skills.

3. When practising Public Presentation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Public Presentation.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Public Presentation.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Public Presentation.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Public Presentation.

4. When practising Phonological awareness: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonological awareness: Pronunciation.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonological awareness: Pronunciation.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological awareness: Pronunciation.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological awareness: Pronunciation.

5. When practising Guided Reading : Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.

6. When practising Phonological awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological awareness.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological awareness.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Phonological awareness.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological awareness.

7. When practising Listening for gist: Main idea., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for gist: Main idea..
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for gist: Main idea..
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for gist: Main idea..
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for gist: Main idea..

8. When practising Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.

9. When practising Self- expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Self- expression.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Self- expression.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Self- expression.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Self- expression.

10. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Reading : Reading Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Reading: Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Reading: Reading Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
